title: Beautiful Bricks
description: This simple resourcepack combines the vibrant old brick textures and the (rather bad) mordern ones. No more hating on bricks!
body:
# Bricks are no longer ugly?! Just look at this fantastic resourcepack made by -UltraFerret- on Reddit . It combines the art styles of the alpha and new versions to create a unique visual feast! I decided to port this to modrinth because most people look here for resourcepacks.
For more such designs, check out this reddit page!
It may show a version warning - it's safe to ignore and it should work just fine.
Also, you can use this in almost any version of the game! You just need to tweak the pack.mcmeta inside. Or don't tweak anything and see if it loads. ## Wanna use it? Just credit -UltraFerret-. And me.
Please note I have explicitly taken permission to upload this project to modrinth from the creator. Reddit page on which this was originally uploaded
The specific comment thread in which I asked for permission (proof of the proof of the proof lol)
